title: Extensions need not be unique
promptMarkdown: On $\mathbb R^2$ with the $\ell^1$ norm, extend $f(t,0)=t$ from the first coordinate axis. Determine every norm-one linear extension. Repeat for the Euclidean norm and explain the difference.
hintLadder: Compute its norm using the relevant dual norm, and prove the lower bound as well.
